preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver a production-presented, spatially reliable cemetery combat slice that preserves the verified movement, dash, input, pause, palette, landmark, and high-angle-camera foundations while adding an inspectable automatic Lantern chain and three genuinely distinct data-driven weapon identities.

diagnosis.root_cause: The active scene procedurally ships its cemetery and Warden from engine primitive meshes; its camera/world composition permits a reachable northeast tree to cover the player; and the floating CharacterBody3D solver can displace the root vertically because velocity.y is cleared only after move_and_slide without restoring the declared plane. Independently, the candidate has no combat, targeting, weapon, damage, death, or drop ownership, so both the automatic Lantern chain and the three distinct weapon/build identities are absent.

stop_conditions: Do not schedule or claim treatment of mournlight.enemies.missing_spawn_roles or any backlog gap in this iteration; a minimum placed legal combat recipient may support the selected combat checks, but full spawning, steering, attacks, pooling, waves, drafts, HUD expansion, and run lifecycle remain outside scope.

Preserve the configured main scene, clean Godot boot, physical WASD/Space/Escape and gamepad bindings with existing deadzones, the single CharacterBody3D velocity writer, independent PresentationRoot facing, dash phase ownership, active-only dash invulnerability, held-input cooldown gating, and pause input-latch reset.

Do not accept visible primitive or untextured proxy art as the repaired presentation. If no lawful, coherent authored environment or Warden presentation passes runtime inspection, report the task incomplete instead of promoting scaffolding.

Keep imported source packages intact and immutable: no mesh extraction, authored-child surgery, destructive source edits, or per-child transform compensation. Bind one intact authored environment instance with only product-owned collision, navigation, spawn/objective anchors, and an outer datum added around it.
Stop after candidate implementation and focused self-validation. GameLoop Runtime and QA Tester own recapture, formal check verdicts, issue closure, and phase closure.

strategy.rationale: Treat the selected work as three bounded root-cause families: first replace the primitive spatial surface while repairing its camera and planar-collision integration; then establish one authoritative automatic-combat causal chain; finally extend that shared chain with distinct weapon strategies and data-driven build mutations. This closes all current active assignments exactly once while advancing the host-selected weapon capability without absorbing deferred enemy, wave, draft, or lifecycle work.

code: Parse/import the exact candidate and boot res://main.tscn with no fatal Godot, GDScript, resource-load, missing-texture, invalid-signal, or recurring runtime errors; retain validate:native_godot_project and validate:host_godot_boot as passing baselines.

Inspect actual runtime bindings and authored source: the active cemetery and Warden presentation must no longer use visible PrimitiveMesh/CSG/untextured proxies, while hidden collision shapes and deliberately authored bounded VFX remain allowed and declared.

Exercise deterministic combat assertions for stable target tie-breaking, cooldown ownership, once-per-hit ledgers, exactly-once death/drop transactions, freed-target rejection, weapon-id uniqueness, upgrade stacking/floors/caps, and Wisp per-target hit intervals.
runtime: GameLoop Runtime and Tester rerun build_wave_expansion_camera_movement_dash_contract using physical keyboard and gamepad-equivalent movement, the recorded held-D east-wall route, diagonal wall slide, dash phases, and pause/resume. Bind the declared plane and Warden transform at 15 Hz or faster; Y must remain within 0.01 world units of that plane.

Repeat the northeast-corner route near the prior recorded location and inspect Warden/camera transforms plus a 1280x720 frame. The complete Warden silhouette, nearby collision context, and a useful escape direction must remain visible.

GameLoop Runtime and Tester rerun build_wave_expansion_automatic_combat_causality_contract from a fresh ordinary-play boot, recording cooldown, stable target id, attack id, hit count, health, hurt, death count, drop count, presentation phases, audio owner, target removal, pause/resume, and clean restart.

GameLoop Runtime and Tester rerun build_wave_expansion_weapon_build_identity_contract with base and representative upgraded legal builds for all three weapons. Compare targeting, cadence, geometry, hit policy, feedback, and authoritative parameter changes; no manual-fire behavior or renamed-projectile strategy may pass.
visual: Capture the shipped 1280x720 gameplay camera at spawn, sustained movement, dash onset/recovery, the northeast route, and one clear view of each landmark. Compare against the bound reference properties: coherent cemetery density, chunky authored silhouettes, warm-versus-cool hierarchy, readable escape lanes, compact HUD, and no visible placeholders.

Inspect the highest-exposure environment, Warden, Lantern-bolt, Gravespade, and Wisp families for geometry, textures/materials, scale, pivots, transparency/additive edges, matte or chroma contamination, variant distribution, and actual runtime binding. Unbound source files do not count.

Capture separated anticipation, onset/active, impact, and recovery frames for each weapon from the representative gameplay camera, plus base-versus-upgraded comparisons. Friendly attacks, hostile recipients, drops, the Warden, and escape space must remain distinguishable without excessive glow or opaque effects.

done_when: The configured main scene uses one intact authored cemetery-garden environment instance and a finished authored Warden presentation under the real camera and lighting. Spawn, loop/cross routes, keeper's lantern post, small mausoleum, cracked moon bell, walls, graves, trees, fences, paths, and ground contact remain readable; visible engine primitives, debug materials, floating props, catalogue-mix.
tasks.instructions: Replace the runtime primitive cemetery builder and primitive Warden body with production-quality authored presentation while preserving the moonlit blue-violet, warm-gold, hostile teal/magenta hierarchy, three landmarks, high-angle play framing, current input ownership, and current dash-state readability. Developer owns bounded asset discovery, preview, audition, and exact selection. Bind exactly one intact authored-environment package as a justified singleton; keep its native terrain/streets, structures, props, materials, and landmarks together, and add only product-owned outer datum, collision/navigation, gameplay boundary, and anchors. Repair collision agreement and camera sight lanes around that binding rather than editing imported children. Resolve planar drift at the authoritative motor/solver boundary: retain one velocity writer, expose the declared movement-plane datum, prevent collision depenetration or sliding from accumulating root Y, and keep diagonal wall sliding useful. Resolve the northeast occlusion with authored sight lanes, camera-aware fading, or transparent occluders while retaining a complete Warden silhouette and escape context at every reachable location. Asset plan 1: family_id=cemetery_environment; prd_style_match=cohesive stylized low-poly/cartoon cemetery with chunky silhouettes, restrained detail, warm-versus-cool lighting, route density, and clear escape lanes; source_quality_class=complete authored environment package, auditioned then accepted; material_and_texture_evidence=inspect native geometry, materials, textures, pivots, scale, ground contact, and actual runtime binding under moonlight, rejecting missing textures, matte-edge contamination, or catalogue mismatch; expected_runtime_uses_or_visible_area_share=one intact instance supplying roughly 70–85 percent of the gameplay view; minimum_distinct_source_variants=1; minimum_runtime_variants=1; maximum_single_variant_share=1.0; diversity_axes=native internal terrain, structures, foliage, graves, props, and landmarks are package-in!
tasks.title: Restore authored arena presentation and reliable planar framing

done_when: From ordinary active play, the starting Warden Lantern repeatedly completes cooldown-ready, deterministic legal-target selection, attack emission, hit resolution, damage, hurt, exactly-once death, and exactly-once drop without fire-button input.
